paris.name: Eiffel Tower (stairs to 2nd floor)
paris.caption: She wears iron better than anyone else wears silk.

paris.name: Sacré-Cœur Basilica
paris.caption: White as a meringue, keeping an eye on the whole affair.

paris.name: Louvre Pyramid & Cour Napoléon
paris.caption: The courtyard at night, when the palace has it to itself.

paris.name: Pont Alexandre III
paris.caption: The most shameless bridge in Paris — and the most correct.

paris.name: Pont Neuf
paris.caption: The 'new bridge', four hundred years into the joke.

bruges.name: Rozenhoedkaai
bruges.caption: The corner every painter in Flanders has attempted. The water does it better.

bruges.name: The Markt
bruges.caption: The Markt and my Belfort — wait for the carriages to clock off.

bruges.name: Groenerei Canal Walk
bruges.caption: My whole town at dusk, lit like a chocolate shop window.

bruges.name: Bonifacius Bridge
bruges.caption: The little bridge everyone swears is medieval. Let them.

bruges.name: Minnewater — the Lake of Love
bruges.credit: Heribert Bechen, 5 million visits - many thanks!
bruges.caption: By the Minnewater — the Lake of Love. I promise nothing, madame.

amsterdam.name: The Canal Ring (Herengracht, Keizersgracht, Prinsengracht)
amsterdam.caption: The whole ring from above — the prettiest trick in town planning.

amsterdam.name: Magere Brug (Skinny Bridge)
amsterdam.caption: The Skinny Bridge, best at dusk when the bulbs come on.

amsterdam.name: Reguliersgracht — the Seven Bridges
amsterdam.caption: Storm light on the Reguliersgracht. Seven bridges from the right spot — I know the spot.

amsterdam.name: Brouwersgracht
amsterdam.caption: Warehouses gone soft in their old age. My favourite water.

amsterdam.name: Vondelpark
amsterdam.caption: The city's shared back garden, madame.
